name: Secure Inventory + Persistence Boundary
changes: Inventory validates content IDs, quantities and ownership; transfer has rollback semantics.
Equipment validates ownership, content existence and slot compatibility.
Persistence provider and PostgreSQL repository contracts added without shipping DB secrets/drivers to mobile clients.
Auth gateway boundary added for future dedicated account/token verification.
Existing Godot/ENet mobile gameplay and V11.1 domains retained.
next: Wire authenticated join lifecycle to session/character resolution.
Implement dedicated PostgreSQL adapter outside mobile client.
Introduce item instance IDs for non-stackable equipment and transactional audit log.
